title: Pattern: a table of text, chosen by a variable
description: Left and right page through a book of sayings. Mechanic: a `tables` list of phrases and a text widget with `pick` and `width`: one widget shows any entry, wrapped to the page, with no widget per phrase.

saying: THE RIVER DOES NOT ASK THE STONE FOR PERMISSION
A LAMP LIT FOR ANOTHER STILL LIGHTS YOUR OWN PATH
WHAT THE FOX FORGETS THE HEDGE REMEMBERS
NO MAP SHOWS THE ROAD HOME TWICE
THE LAST STAIR IS ALWAYS THE LOUDEST

scenarios.name: right twice turns to the third saying
left from the first page wraps to the last
